identity.name: Pelagos 39
identity.one_liner: A 39mm titanium diver without a date window, sized down from the standard 42mm Pelagos while keeping the matte black finish, snowflake hands, and chronometer movement.

narrative.story: Introduced in 2022, the Pelagos 39 drops the date window and shrinks the case to 39mm from the standard Pelagos's 42mm, using the same grade-2 titanium construction and MT5400 chronometer movement as the rest of the line. It targets buyers who want Pelagos build quality without the larger case.
narrative.collector_notes: The 47mm lug-to-lug and 12mm thickness are what actually separate this from other 39-40mm divers on paper, so buyers used to a Black Bay Fifty-Eight's wrist feel should try this on before assuming the stated diameter alone tells the story.
